data.title: Vehicle tax notice from 1 January 2025 (€186 per year)
data.summary: The Hauptzollamt Musterhafen set the vehicle tax (Kraftfahrzeugsteuer) for vehicle MH-BK 510 at €186.00 per year from 1 January 2025. The tax is collected yearly in advance by direct debit.
data.explanation: This is a vehicle tax assessment (Kraftfahrzeugsteuerbescheid) from the customs office. It fixes your yearly tax at €186.00 from 1 January 2025, collected in advance by direct debit, so make sure your account has enough money. If you think the assessment is wrong, you may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or electronically with the issuing office. The app shows the deadline. If you don't object by then, the assessment becomes final. A tax adviser can help if you are unsure.

items.title: File objection against vehicle tax notice (optional)
items.action: If you disagree with the assessment, file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or electronically with the Hauptzollamt Musterhafen.
items.consequence: After the deadline the assessment becomes final and can no longer be challenged.
items.quote: Er ist innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe bei der erlassenden Behörde schriftlich oder elektronisch einzulegen.

items.title: Yearly vehicle tax by direct debit
items.action: Keep enough money in your account for the yearly direct debit of the vehicle tax.
items.quote: Die Steuer wird jährlich im Voraus durch Lastschrift eingezogen.
